summary: Temporary danger area EGD196A active from surface to 450 ft for unmanned aircraft flights beyond visual line of sight, at EGLC.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD196A ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 134/2026 
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE 
TDA. EMERG SER AND MIL OPS REQUIRING IMMEDIATE ACCESS TO THE TDA 
SHOULD CTC HEATHROW RADAR ON FREQ 125.625MHZ. FOR OTHER CREWED ACFT 
OR VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT OPS ACCESS, CTC THE OPERATOR 72 HOURS PRIOR 
TO OPS COMMENCING ON 01332 319137 OR VIA EMAIL 
FLIGHTOPS.UK(AT)MATTERNET.COM. AR-2026-4899/49.
